This suggests that Moniliforminol A may act as a modulator of the SR-9009-mediated transport of Alpha globin. Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1 is a key player in the transport of various organic anions, including those involved in metabolic processes. The integration of these pathways implies that Moniliforminol A could influence the transport of Alpha globin, potentially affecting its function in cellular processes. The evidence suggests a possible role for Moniliforminol A in regulating the activity of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1, though the exact mechanism remains to be elucidated.
